body:
Fix corrupt input handling in the Parquet reader:

- Check Boolean PLAIN bounds before reading a value. A truncated page could otherwise return values from padding or read beyond the buffer.
- Reject DELTA_BYTE_ARRAY encoding for types other than BYTE_ARRAY and FIXED_LEN_BYTE_ARRAY, rather than passing reconstructed byte-array data to an incompatible reader.
- Reject NULL VARIANT metadata before decoding it. A non-NULL object with NULL metadata could otherwise cause an invalid memory read.
- Upgrade row-group column-count mismatches in `parquet_metadata()` from an `InternalException` to `DataCorruptionException`
title: Validate more Parquet values and metadata
